record.body:
verdict: PASS
findings: []
integration:
  interfaces: |
    orchestra/views.py: HOOK_ROLE_NAMES, HOOK_ROLES and HOOK_VIEW (HANDOFF restricted to the six hook roles). _group_records and _group_lines are extracted from render_view, and _record_line gains a link flag (default True), so handoff output keeps its id links. live_efforts(records) returns the subjects of active, non-closed score:effort records; positions no longer make an effort live, which closes the earlier spec-gap. hook_handoff_sections(records) returns (label, text) tuples in three tiers: live efforts with a position stamp (position recorded_at, newest first), then live efforts without a stamp (alphabetical), then every other group (alphabetical). The "other" tier covers effortless groups, off-slug blocking questions and closed efforts, which fixes the earlier dropped-groups behavior-bug. An effortless group is labelled by its item subjects. hook_constraints filters on the live-effort set. orchestra/stage/hooks.py: HOOK_CONTEXT_BUDGET=9000 and MAX_HOOK_CONSTRAINTS=20. _assemble_start builds protocol, constraint lines, the "# Project Handoff" sections, the "Not shown: ..." line and the footer, adding sections in order while the full build stays at or under 9000 characters. cmd_start still catches exceptions and returns a one-line error context, and still writes no records. tests/test_hooks.py covers R1-R12, tests/test_hooks_dropped_groups.py covers R14 and the goal-closed form of R5, and tests/test_views.py covers R11 through the CLI.
  assumptions: |
    Excluded material ignored; the brief contained none. tests/test_hooks.py, tests/test_hooks_dropped_groups.py and tests/test_views.py in the phase worktree: 57 passed. R13 check with the phase code against the primary store, scratch ORCHESTRA_BASELINE_DIR: additionalContext 8,918 characters (limit 10,000), ending with "Not shown: evidence-layer, canon-cli-ergonomics, session-analysis, test-suite-speed. Run `orchestra handoff --effort <slug>`." and the footer. Bare `pytest` on the whole tree fails at collection with a conftest REPO_ROOT import error; the README runs its four pytest commands separately; not investigated.
  invariants: |
    Hooks never write records (cmd_start only reads; test_hooks_never_write_records exists): holds. A hook failure returns a one-line error context: holds. The start context stays within budget (full build including omitted line and footer checked against 9000): holds. `orchestra handoff` output unchanged (render_view keeps link=True; R11 tests): holds. R5 and R14 re-check: closed goal makes an effort non-live even with an open position (tested); effortless and off-slug items stay in the rest tier and appear or are named (three R14 tests). Minor observations, not findings: for an effortless group the omitted line names item subjects, and `orchestra handoff --effort <subject>` would not display those items because _in_effort matches on effort or scope; R14 only requires naming, so acceptable. The omitted line is unbudgeted when many groups are omitted; the 1,000-character gap to the cap absorbs it, as the design accepts.
  conflicts: none
record.subject: hook-context-budget-review
